experience-1.description: REST and SOAP API development, enterprise applications, and production system maintenance.
worked-on: Developed and integrated REST and SOAP APIs to connect enterprise systems and enable data exchange between applications.
Developed and maintained enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, PHP, and Laravel, implementing new features and business requirements.
Implemented CFDI e-invoicing features supporting the generation and management of electronic invoices.
Designed and modeled relational and NoSQL databases to support application requirements and business processes.
Implemented authentication and authorization mechanisms to control access to web applications and resources.
Resolved bugs and performed application maintenance in production environments, supporting system availability and continuity.
Gathered requirements directly from users and translated them into business-focused software features.
Integrated biometric access-control systems into enterprise processes and identification workflows.
Documented code and application functionality to improve maintainability and knowledge transfer.
Managed and followed up on support tickets, diagnosing and resolving issues related to enterprise applications.

experience-2.description: IT infrastructure, database administration, network troubleshooting, and internal software projects.
worked-on: Administered SQL Server, MySQL, and MariaDB databases, performing queries, updates, and maintenance tasks for enterprise systems.
Developed and integrated internal projects focused on improving operational processes.
Designed and executed software tests to validate new features before deployment.
Designed responsive web interfaces for different devices and screen sizes.
Diagnosed LAN/WAN connectivity issues using tools such as ping, tracert/traceroute, ipconfig/ifconfig, and nslookup.
Configured and administered Windows and Linux servers, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, FTP, and web services.
Implemented basic security measures across systems and networks, including firewalls, antivirus, and access policies.
